acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction can coordinate the installation for a wide range of household appliances, including refrigerators, ovens, cooktops, dishwashers, microwaves, washing machines, and dryers. We handle both built-in and freestanding units, ensuring proper electrical, plumbing, and ventilation connections according to manufacturer specifications and local codes.
